reviews.comment: Quite possibly the least writing-intensive writing-intensive class of all time. That being said, this is still the most fulfilling class I have EVER taken at Texas A&M, and Dr. Zimmer is the best professor I've had. Don't skip class, and be sure to do her extra credit because there is a lot.
The kindest woman ever! I have taken her 265 course and now do research under her. She genuinely cares so much about her students and their growth, both academically and personally.
Took Dr Zimmer for 265 and she genuinely tried to get to know me throughout the semester. Felt very inspired after leaving her class and she tried to make sure every student was doing well.

Dr. Zimmer is by far the best professor I have ever had. She deeply cares about her students and wants to see them succeed. I went through some personal things this semester, and she continued to check up on me, which meant the world. Dr. Zimmer is a gem, she's taught me so many invaluable lessons that I will never forget.
She is the best professor I have ever had. You can tell she deeply cares about her job and all of her students. Go to class, do the work, ask for help, and you will be completely fine.

Easily the best professor you will have in college. Cares so much about her students, you cannot do bad in this class as long as you SHOW UP! She will always be there to answer questions! The most helpful professor I have had in college, this class may seem daunting with the writing assignments but Dr.Zimmer is spectacular! 100/10 would recommend!!

Dr. Zimmer is by far the best professor I have had in college. She is so good at conveying the information, and she builds a structure in class that makes doing poorly impossible. She cares about each student so much. She is so uplifting. Be glad you get the chance to be her student, because there is not many other professors like her.

Amazing Professor! Cares about her students like they are her children. Would recommend taking her, you feel so comfortable in her class regardless of the assignments, especially the presentations. Work is easy, and make sure to work ahead. She is so nice and wants the best out of everyone.

One of the best professors I have ever had. She cares about her students so much and wants you to be successful! She is super knowledgeable on all things in the industry and as long as you go to class you will learn so much! Absolutely take her class every chance you get!
Dr. Zimmer knows what she is teaching and cares drastically for her students. She treats her students as her own.

She really cares about her students and takes them into consideration. She makes the class really simple by making sure you do not fall behind. She has a very clear calendar for the semester and has a lot of material to help guide you through the semester. 100% would recommend.

Dr. Zimmer is the BEST professor I have ever had. She is kind, compassionate, and truly has a love for teaching. She genuinely cares about you and what's going on in your life. She doesn't grade too hard and just wants you to succeed! We never gave a speech to the entire class but instead only to small groups to improve public speaking. LOVE HER!!!

she is a great professor and I would definitely take her again if I could. I know I put she gives lots of work which isn't false, however, she goes over a lot of it in class. Also if you ever need more help she is there and willing to explain in detail how to proceed with your assignment, and although lecture heavy shehelps with work DONT be scared
Ignore every bad review she has. Professor Zimmer is a gem and the best professor I have had at A&M. Would take her again 100/100. I still email her to catch up and I took her class last semester!
Grading criteria is applied unevenly and seemingly whenever she feels like it. Lectures are exhaustive and boring, would not recommend

Overzealous at times and does not present the information in a very user friendly way. Seems to give out As on little grades but when it Comes to major projects she suddenly becomes a strict grader. Uses weird programs like perceptive that make the class more difficult than it needs to be
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: gives lots of extra credit. very lenient grader. not very strict. wants to see the best in her students. goal of her class is to create out-of-classroom opportunities/gain an internship

She's awesome! There are no tests in this class only papers and projects. She provides a ton of feedback and you can send your project to her first to get feedback before submitting for a grade. She does take attendance but you get two free skips.

Dr. Zimmer is the best! She is so caring about her students, and works hard to make each class interesting. I have actually learned a lot from her and would love to take one of her classes again! The only complaint I have is her attendance policy, but overall it's worth it to have such a great professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Not only the best professor I have ever had, but one of the best people I have ever met. She taught the subject very well & went above and beyond by giving us insight on the industry and truly cared about us as people. No tests, and all assignments helped expand my knowledge about myself and how to be successful in the real world. Love this woman!!

Took this class as a summer session. NO TESTS. A couple of projects, that are so clearly outlined that itd be hard to mess them up. Dr. Zimmer is seriously the sweetest, most caring person ever. Shes always willing to help you whether it be with work for her class or real life resumes and interviews, she wants to make your dreams come true.
